description: This file defines an interface named StreamFactoryInterface within the PSR\Http\Message namespace. It specifies methods for creating stream objects from strings, files, and resources, serving as a contract for implementations related to stream creation in HTTP message handling.

classes.name: StreamFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface that declares methods for creating stream objects from various sources such as strings, files, and resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream from a string content, ideally using a temporary resource.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing file or URI, open mode specified, possibly throwing exceptions if file cannot be opened or mode is invalid.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing PHP resource that must be readable, and may be writable.
